maya: Quick heads-up — I have a conference call tomorrow and need someone to cover oncall 18:00–22:00 PST. Can anyone take it? I can prewarm model variants & leave handoff notes. @liam @sophia
liam: I can do 18:00–20:00. Will need handoff steps + any weirds to watch for. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks! Putting notes here — prewarm prefix cache and bump batch cap to 64 for the evening. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prewarm
maya: ```
# quick prewarm
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/prewarm -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium","prefix":"/user/preview"}'
# increase batch cap
kubectl patch config redwood-serving -p '{"spec":{"batch_max":64}}'
```
sophia: I can pick up 20:00–22:00 if that works. I'll be remote but available. Ahmed, you free to pair 19:30–20:30 for handoff overlap?
ahmed: I can do 19:30–22:00, but FYI infra has a planned instance scaling tonight around 21:45 — I can watch but might be idling. Recommend setting fallback policy to medium-large model variant at 21:30.
liam: noted. @deploy-bot can you add an oncall swap note for tomorrow? I'll update calendar.
deploy-bot: schedule update: Oncall swap recorded — liam 18:00–20:00, ahmed 20:00–22:00, sophia standby 20:00–22:00. Link: https://calendar.redwood/evt/2315554321
maya: thanks all. I'll leave a short checklist in the runbook channel and DM creds to liam. :pray:
ahmed: quick check — if KV cache warm fails, fallback command is `curl https://ops.redwood/warm/fallback`. I'll paste in runbook.
sophia: All good. I'll join the 19:30 handover call for 10m. ping me if anything spikes. :rocket:
liam: Got it. See you all tomorrow.
